items.title: Chazz Frichtel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 13, 2016
items.q: I think Ted Templeman was producing Mike at that point.

ctx.x: Now do those type of guys use different players in the studio than they do live?

Yeah. Usually. Although I did some session work with Mike but normally that call — it seems like it comes down to the producer, and the producer calls his guys, and I think Ted Templeman was producing Mike at that point. And I’ve got to say though, that was a little bit of a tough pill to swallow, only because I felt like certainly the guys in the touring band were capable of recording, but I don’t think it was really Mike’s call because the producers control the money and — but Mike was kind of, we got in there…
Yeah I know what you mean by loud. Because I’ve played in some loud bands and that can be —
